pattern: Each panel lays an absolute tint over its own text and chip, its opacity pulsing on every cue; a cue's sample can land on the pulse's peak

packet.spoken: The north desk sorted the parcels by street. Then the south desk weighed each crate, and once the van came in, the last load arrived.

module: const clamp = (x: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
const cues = { north: useCue("north"), sorted: useCue("sorted"), south: useCue("south"), weighed: useCue("weighed"), van: useCue("van"), arrived: useCue("arrived") };
const pulse = (at: number) => (t < at ? 0 : clamp(1 - (t - at)));
const southPulse = Math.max(pulse(cues.south), pulse(cues.weighed), pulse(cues.van), pulse(cues.arrived));

const panel = { position: "relative", flex: 1, padding: 40, borderRadius: 24, border: "3px solid var(--color-border-prominent)", background: "var(--color-background-subtle)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 28 } as const;
const tint = (p: number) => ({ position: "absolute", inset: 0, borderRadius: 24, background: "var(--color-brand-primary-solid)", opacity: p * 0.2 }) as const;
const text = { position: "relative", margin: 0, fontSize: 52, fontWeight: 700, color: "var(--color-text-primary)" } as const;

const chip = { position: "relative", alignSelf: "flex-start", padding: "10px 28px", borderRadius: 999, fontSize: 44, fontWeight: 700, background: "var(--color-brand-primary-solid)", color: "var(--color-on-brand-primary)", clipPath: clip(cues.arrived) } as const;
<div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, display: "flex", gap: 40, padding: 60, alignItems: "flex-start", boxSizing: "border-box" }}>
